name: disk-watch
description: Track where your disk space went, snapshot by snapshot.
author: Andreas Lundgren

scripts.scanner: vp exec node scripts/cargo.mjs build --release --manifest-path scanner/Cargo.toml
scripts.dev: vp run scanner && vp exec electron-vite dev
scripts.build: vp run scanner && vp exec electron-vite build
scripts.dist:win: vp run build && vp exec electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.test: vp run scanner && vp test run
scripts.test:rust: vp exec node scripts/cargo.mjs test --manifest-path scanner/Cargo.toml
scripts.format: vp exec prettier --write src scripts electron.vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.verify: vp run build && vp exec node scripts/verify.ts
scripts.app: vp run build && vp exec node scripts/start-app.mjs
scripts.ready: vp run test && vp run test:rust && vp run typecheck && vp run verify && vp run dist:win && vp run verify:packaged
scripts.dist:mac: vp run build && vp exec node scripts/mac-icon.mjs && vp exec electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --publish never
scripts.verify:windows: vp run build && vp exec node scripts/verify.ts
